messages:
Ethan (CS): Kicking off CedarValley onboarding. They want a 3-week pilot to test KB embeddings + quick-reply snippets in their agent UI. Priya is the PM. Renewal review in ~50 days; we should surface metrics aligned to renewal. Who can own integration, runtime, and training? :wave:

Priya (CedarValley): Hi all Thanks Ethan. Success targets: 20% drop in AHT for targeted flows, precision@3 >0.7, and p95 <=180ms. We'll provide sanitized KB export + 2 days of transcripts by EOD tomorrow.

Logan (Solutions): I'll own integration + prompt set. Plan: Day0 access & schema map, Day5 prototype endpoint + UI hook, Day12 retrieval tuning + evals, Day18 canary readout. Need to confirm auth method (API key vs mTLS).

Nora (Eng): I'll take runtime sizing, caching, and canary rollout. Suggest hosted prototype; set fallback to Private if compliance arises. Action for Priya: send concurrent agent count and peak qps.

Ben (Enablement): I'll prepare a 60m workshop + quick-start playbook. Need two support reps to join canary for shadowing and feedback.

reminder-bot: Meeting created: "CedarValley Onboard Kickoff" in 48h with Priya, Logan, Nora, Ben, Ethan.

Ethan (CS): Risks: procurement/renewal window (~50d) and embedding index cost if full KB ingested. We'll prioritize renewal-linked metrics.

Logan (Solutions): Cost rough: prototype sampling ~35k tokens/week; full pilot up to ~150k tokens/week. I'll add a sampling plan.

Nora (Eng): Action items for Priya: KB export format, avg doc length, concurrent agents. Also confirm PII status.

Priya (CedarValley): Will send KB export + doc stats tomorrow morning. No PII in samples. Concurrent agents: avg 7, peak 22.

Ethan (CS): Quick pinned summary:
````
Owners & Deadlines:
- Logan: integration + prototype (due Day5)
- Nora: runtime sizing + canary plan (due Day9)
- Ben: enablement + workshop (due Day14)
- Priya: KB export + transcripts (due Day1/EOD)
- Ethan: pilot dashboard & renewal metrics (due Day3)
Risks: procurement review at ~Day50; embedding cost if full KB used.
Success criteria (CedarValley): 20% AHT reduction, precision@3 >0.7, p95 <=180ms
````
I'll share a one-pager and a tracking doc post-kickoff. Ping me to swap owners. :thumbsup:
